summary: I found no P0 or P1 issues, so this is ready to merge. The change makes `installProject` retry once when the app VM's first start fails with an `AppSandboxError`, which covers fresh VMs that miss the 30 s readiness window. The retry is safe: the supervisor's `start` stops any existing container first and runs under a global lock, and a failed `run_app` cleans up its own container. The temp test fails without the change and checks both cases: one failure is retried and leaves the app running, and two failures still fail the install with the supervisor's reason. All 5 changed lines are covered.
